units.source_text: 匂亲王看了想道：“如果我的心也无常而易变，确是可叹的了。”

en.t: Prince Niou saw this and thought, "If my own heart is also fickle and easily changed, that would truly be lamentable."

units.source_text: 便觉浮舟十分可怜，笑着问她：“你曾看见谁人对你变心？”

en.t: He felt deeply sorry for Ukifune, and asked her with a smile, "Whom have you ever seen change his heart toward you?"

units.source_text: 便频频探询薰大将当初送她来此的情由。

en.t: He then kept pressing her to explain why General Kaoru had originally sent her here.

units.source_text: 浮舟不胜其苦，答道：“我不愿意说的，你何必定要盘问？”

en.t: Ukifune could hardly bear the distress and replied, "If I do not want to speak of it, why must you keep questioning me?"

units.source_text: 其娇嗔之相亦复天真可爱。

en.t: Her pouting, coquettish manner was innocent and charming as well.

units.source_text: 匂亲王心念此事将来自会知道，便不强迫她说了。

en.t: Prince Niou thought that he would naturally learn the truth in time, and so he did not force her to speak.
